headline: More than 20 million households face hosepipe bans in drought
summary: More than 20 million households are under hosepipe bans as low rainfall and high demand put pressure on supplies.
script: More than twenty million households face hosepipe bans after drought was declared in parts of England. Low rainfall and high demand are putting pressure on supplies as summer continues.
imageAlt: A dry landscape illustrating drought and hosepipe restrictions in England.
imageAltTwo: A second drought image connected to hosepipe restrictions.

sources.title: Hosepipe bans in force as drought declared

selection.basis: Large household count gives the number-first opening immediate human scale; ranking is editorial, not an objective trend metric.
